streams.name: General
streams.description: Default stream for ad-hoc tasks and assistant chats.

streams.description: Market briefings — NSE/BSE + NYSE/NASDAQ via finance agents.

streams.name: Research

pipelines.name: Quick answer
pipelines.description: Single assistant pass for simple questions.

pipelines.name: Review then fix
pipelines.description: Coder reviews, assistant summarizes the fix.

pipelines.name: Finance brief
pipelines.description: Finance agent briefs, summarizer compresses for Discord.

pipelines.name: US finance brief
pipelines.description: US finance agent briefs, summarizer compresses for Discord.

pipelines.name: Scout then brief
pipelines.description: Scout researches, summarizer compresses for Discord.

pipelines.name: Deep dive
pipelines.description: Scout researches, coder reviews implications, assistant summarizes.

pipelines.name: Deep research
pipelines.description: Scout gathers, analyst verdicts, critic red-teams, writer publishes. Quality-gated.

pipelines.name: Ship review
pipelines.description: Coder drafts, critic gates SHIP/REWORK, assistant summarizes.

taskTypes.name: Bug fix
taskTypes.description: Repro, fix, test, verify — repeatable per bug report.
taskTypes.inputLabel: Bug report (what breaks, steps to repro, expected vs actual)

taskTypes.name: Feature build
taskTypes.description: Scope, implement, test, summarize — repeatable per feature request.
taskTypes.inputLabel: Feature request (what to build, acceptance criteria)

taskTypes.name: Regression check
taskTypes.description: Tester sweeps a scope, critic gates, assistant reports — repeatable per release.
taskTypes.inputLabel: Scope to regression-test (area, release, risk notes)

taskTypes.name: Tech spike
taskTypes.description: Scout researches, analyst verdicts, tester writes acceptance tests, writer publishes — repeatable per open question. Fully testable: needs no repo, only web research.
taskTypes.inputLabel: Open question to spike (what to research, decision needed, constraints)
